title: Railroad yard job and returning home to New Orleans in 1921
summary: With the club closed Williams takes a Southern Pacific yard job, is left stranded when a drummer friend goes to Frisco, and goes home in March 1921 to join Buddy Petit, then Sam Morgan.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
